title: 第0101章 大比前夕药力淬体震全场第0100章 长老博弈 暗夜追杀 人参碎片现谷
content_zh:
------
青炎域的清晨，薄雾还未散尽，林家演武场上却已人声鼎沸。
三日之后，便是林家三年一度的家族大比。对于所有林家年轻子弟而言，这是一场决定资源分配、地位高低，甚至是未来能否进入青炎城各大宗门的关键之战。偌大的演武场边缘，此刻挤满了前来晨练和切磋的族人。拳风呼啸，兵器碰撞的铿锵声不绝于耳，空气中弥漫着汗水和铁锈混合的气息。
而在演武场中央最引人注目的擂台旁，一群身着锦缎华服的年轻子弟正簇拥着一个白衣少年。
那少年面容俊朗，眉宇间却透着一股与生俱来的倨傲。他随手将手中一柄精钢长剑抛给身旁的家仆，接过丝帕慢条斯理地擦了擦手，目光扫过周围那些投来敬畏目光的族人，嘴角勾起一抹志得意满的弧度。
正是林家少主，林啸天。
“天哥，这次大比，那几个旁系的废物估计连第一轮都撑不过去。”一个尖嘴猴腮的跟班凑上前，脸上堆满了谄媚的笑容，“尤其是那个林药尘，听说前几天还在后山捡柴火呢，真不知道他哪来的脸报名大比。”
林啸天闻言，嗤笑一声，眼中闪过一丝阴冷的讥诮：“一个天生绝脉的废物罢了。若不是族长念在他是林家血脉的份上，早就该被逐出家族自生自灭了。这次大比，我倒要看看，他怎么在我的脚下摇尾乞怜。”
话音未落，演武场入口处突然传来一阵轻微的骚动。
众人下意识地循声望去，只见一个身着灰色旧袍的少年，正迈着不疾不徐的步伐走进场内。他身形略显单薄，面容清秀却带着几分病态的苍白，但那一双深邃的眼眸中，却透着一股与年龄不符的沉稳与坚毅。
林药尘。
“哟，这不是我们林家的‘绝脉天才’吗？”那个尖嘴猴腮的跟班立刻扯着嗓子喊了起来，声音尖锐刺耳，瞬间吸引了全场的目光，“怎么，药尘堂弟，你是来演武场看热闹的，还是来给我们天哥助威的？可别靠太近，万一你那身子骨受不了咱们练武的气劲，当场吐血可就不好了。”
周围顿时爆发出一阵哄笑。
林药尘的脚步没有丝毫停顿，甚至连眼皮都没抬一下，仿佛根本没有听到那刺耳的嘲讽。他径直走向演武场中央的一块青石卧虎桩，伸手按在粗糙的石面上，轻轻吐纳了一口浊气。
这一幕，落在林啸天等人眼中，更是显得格外可笑。
“装模作样。”林啸天冷哼一声，负手而立，“我看他是知道自己必败无疑，想在死前摆个样子，也好让自己死得‘体面’一点。”
然而，就在下一秒——
异变陡生！
林药尘那只按在卧虎桩上的手掌，突然泛起了一层淡淡的、近乎透明的金色光泽。紧接着，一股灼热而狂暴的气息，如同沉睡的火山般从他瘦削的身体里轰然爆发！
轰！

以林药尘为中心，一圈肉眼可见的气浪猛地扩散开来。卧虎桩周围的尘埃被瞬间吹散，距离他最近的几个林家子弟甚至被这股突如其来的气劲逼得连连后退，脸上满是骇然。
“这……这是什么气息？！”
“好强的药力波动！他难道在炼药？不对，他没有药鼎啊！”
“不可能！他明明是个绝脉废柴，怎么会爆发出这么恐怖的力量？！”
惊呼声此起彼伏。所有人都瞪大了眼睛，难以置信地看着场中央的那个少年。
此时的林药尘，双目紧闭，周身金光缭绕。在他的体内，刚刚炼化不久的【仙茅】药力正如同沸腾的岩浆般奔涌不息。【仙茅】，破障壮阳，激发潜能，正是他此时用来强行打通体内闭塞经脉、淬炼肉身的绝对利器！
随着药力的全面运转，林药尘的皮肤下隐隐浮现出一道道淡金色的脉络，那是药力深入骨髓、强化体魄的直观表现。他能清晰地感觉到，自己原本千疮百孔的经脉正在被这股霸道的药力一寸寸拓宽、加固。每一次呼吸，都伴随着骨骼轻微的爆鸣声，那是力量在疯狂增长的信号！
【叮！仙茅药力淬体完成度：30%……40%……50%！】
脑海中，万古药尊系统的提示音不断响起。
林药尘猛地睁开双眼，两道精芒如同实质般从眼底射出，转瞬即逝。他缓缓收回按在石面上的手掌，低头看去——那坚硬无比的青石卧虎桩表面，竟然被他掌心的余温烤出了一片焦黑的痕迹！
全场死寂。
刚才还嚣张跋扈的尖嘴猴腮跟班，此刻张大了嘴巴，仿佛能塞进一个鸡蛋。他揉了揉眼睛，怀疑自己是不是产生了幻觉。
林啸天的脸色，也在这一瞬间变得极为难看。他死死盯着林药尘，拳头不自觉地握紧，指节因为用力过度而泛白。他能清楚地感受到，从林药尘身上传来的那股压迫感，竟然丝毫不弱于自己这个已经修炼到聚气境三重的“天才”！
“怎么可能……”林啸天心中掀起了惊涛骇浪，“这废物明明中了我的腐骨散，经脉尽断，怎么可能还能修炼？而且还拥有了如此可怕的药力波动？！”
他猛地想起前几日派去查看林药尘死活的心腹回来报告，说那废物不仅没死，反而红光满面地在后山挖草根。当时他还以为是手下敷衍了事，如今看来……
“林药尘，你果然藏了一手。”林啸天眼中闪过一丝狠厉的杀机，但很快又被他掩饰下去。他冷笑一声，故意拔高了音量，让整个演武场都能听到：
“不错嘛，看来这几天没少偷偷摸摸地啃草根进补。可惜，大比不是比谁吃得多，而是比谁拳头硬。你这点三脚猫的把式，在我面前，依旧不堪一击！”
这番话，既给自己找了台阶下，又试图将林药尘的异常归结为“歪门邪道”。
果然，周围的议论声再次响起。
“少主说得对，这林药尘肯定是用了什么邪门丹药强行提升的，药效一过肯定废了。”

“就是，他一个绝脉，怎么可能真的逆天改命？少主可是聚气境三重的高手，一招就能把他打趴下！”
content_en:
------
In the early morning in Qingyan Domain, the mist has not yet cleared, but the Lin family's martial arts arena is already bustling with people.
Three days later, there will be the Lin family's triennial family competition. For all the young children of the Lin family, this is a key battle that determines resource allocation, status, and even whether they can enter the major sects in Qingyan City in the future. The edge of the huge martial arts arena was now crowded with clan members who came for morning exercises and sparring sessions. The wind of fists roared, the clang of weapons clashing was endless, and the air was filled with the smell of sweat and rust.
Next to the most eye-catching ring in the center of the martial arts arena, a group of young men dressed in brocade and gorgeous clothes were surrounding a young man in white.
The young man had a handsome face, but there was an innate arrogance between his brows. He casually threw a fine steel sword in his hand to the servant beside him, took the silk handkerchief and wiped his hands slowly. His eyes swept over the surrounding tribesmen who were looking at him in awe, and the corners of his mouth curved with a smile of satisfaction.
It was Lin Xiaotian, the young master of the Lin family.
"Brother Tian, in this competition, those losers from the sidelines probably won't be able to survive the first round." A sharp-tongued follower came forward with a flattering smile on his face, "Especially that Lin Yaochen. I heard he was collecting firewood in the back mountain a few days ago. I really don't know how he got the nerve to sign up for the competition."
Hearing this, Lin Xiaotian sneered, with a hint of cold ridicule flashing in his eyes: "He is just a waste who was born with no bloodline. If the patriarch hadn't thought that he was of the Lin family's blood, he would have been expelled from the family to fend for himself. In this competition, I want to see how he can beg for mercy at my feet."
Before he finished speaking, a slight commotion suddenly came from the entrance to the martial arts arena.
Everyone subconsciously followed the sound and saw a young man wearing an old gray robe walking into the venue at a leisurely pace. His figure was slightly thin, and his face was delicate but somewhat sickly pale, but his deep eyes revealed a calmness and perseverance that belied his age.
Lin Yaochen.
"Hey, isn't this the 'Pulse Genius' of our Lin family?" The sharp-mouthed and monkey-cheeked follower immediately shouted at the top of his lungs. His voice was shrill and harsh, instantly attracting the attention of the audience. "Why, cousin Yaochen, are you here to watch the show, or are you here to cheer for our brother Tian? Don't get too close. If your body can't stand the strength of our martial arts training, it will be bad to vomit blood on the spot."
There was a burst of laughter all around.
Lin Yaochen's footsteps didn't pause at all, and he didn't even raise his eyelids, as if he didn't hear the harsh taunt at all. He walked straight to a bluestone Crouching Tiger Stake in the center of the martial arts arena, stretched out his hand and pressed it on the rough stone surface, and breathed out a breath of turbid air.
This scene looked even more ridiculous in the eyes of Lin Xiaotian and others.
"Pretending." Lin Xiaotian snorted coldly and stood with his hands behind his hands. "I think he knew that he was bound to lose, and wanted to put on a show before he died so that he could die a more 'honourable' death."
However, in the next second——
A sudden change occurred!
Lin Yaochen's palm, which was pressed against the Crouching Tiger Post, suddenly glowed with a faint, almost transparent golden luster. Immediately afterwards, a hot and violent breath burst out from his thin body like a sleeping volcano!
boom!
With Lin Yaochen as the center, a circle of air waves visible to the naked eye suddenly spread out. The dust around the crouching tiger pile was blown away instantly, and the Lin family disciples closest to him were even forced to retreat by the sudden energy, with shock on their faces.
"This...what kind of breath is this?!"
"What a strong medicinal power fluctuation! Is he refining medicine? No, he doesn't have a medicine cauldron!"
"Impossible! He is obviously a useless person, how could he burst out with such terrifying power?!"
Exclamations came and went. Everyone's eyes widened and they looked at the young man in the center of the field in disbelief.At this time, Lin Yaochen's eyes were tightly closed, and his whole body was surrounded by golden light. In his body, the power of the [curculigo] that had just been refined was surging like boiling magma. [Curculum], which breaks barriers, strengthens yang, and stimulates potential, is the absolute weapon he uses to forcefully open the blocked meridians in the body and temper the body at this time!
As the power of the medicine was fully operational, lines of light golden veins faintly appeared under Lin Yaochen's skin, which was an intuitive manifestation of the power of the medicine penetrating into the bone marrow and strengthening the body. He could clearly feel that his originally riddled meridians were being widened and strengthened inch by inch by this overbearing medicinal power. Every breath is accompanied by a slight crackling sound of bones, which is a signal that the strength is growing crazily!
【bite! Curculigo medicinal power quenching completion degree: 30%...40%...50%! 】
In his mind, the beeps of the Eternal Medicine Master system kept ringing.
Lin Yaochen opened his eyes suddenly, and two rays of light shot out from the bottom of his eyes as if they were real, and they disappeared in an instant. He slowly withdrew his palm from the stone surface and looked down - the surface of the extremely hard bluestone Crouching Tiger Stake was actually burnt black by the residual heat of his palm!
The whole place was dead silent.
The sharp-mouthed monkey-cheeked follower who was arrogant and domineering just now opened his mouth so wide that it seemed like he could stuff an egg into it. He rubbed his eyes, wondering if he was hallucinating.
Lin Xiaotian's face also became extremely ugly at this moment. He stared at Lin Yaochen, clenching his fists unconsciously, his knuckles turning white from excessive exertion. He could clearly feel that the oppressive feeling coming from Lin Yaochen was no weaker than that of himself, a "genius" who had reached the third level of Qi Gathering Realm!
"How is it possible..." Lin Xiaotian's heart stirred up a storm, "This piece of trash has obviously been hit by my rotten bone powder and its meridians have been severed. How can it be possible that he can still practice? And he also has such terrifying fluctuations in the power of the medicine?!"
He suddenly remembered that the confidant sent to check Lin Yaochen's life and death a few days ago came back and reported that the good-for-nothing was not only not dead, but was digging grass roots in the back mountain with a glowing face. At that time, he thought it was because his subordinates were perfunctory, but now it seems...
"Lin Yaochen, you really hid something." Lin Xiaotian's eyes flashed with murderous intent, but he quickly concealed it. He sneered and deliberately raised the volume so that the entire martial arts arena could hear:
"Not bad, it seems that I have been secretly nibbling grass roots to supplement my body these past few days. Unfortunately, the competition is not about who eats more, but who has stronger fists. Even with your three-legged cat skills, you are still vulnerable to me!"
These words not only gave him a way out, but also tried to attribute Lin Yaochen's abnormality to "crooked ways".
Sure enough, the surrounding discussions started again.
"Young Master is right, this Lin Yaochen must have used some evil elixir to forcibly improve it. Once the effect of the medicine wears off, it will definitely be useless."
"That's right, how can he really change his destiny if he has no pulse? The young master is a master of the third level of Qi Gathering Realm. He can be knocked down with one move!"
